title: Oldschool Legacy Dyes
description: A texture pack that restores the classic legacy dye textures, replacing the modern Minecraft dye designs with their old-school look.
body:
**Legacy Dye** is a texture pack designed for players who miss the charm of Minecraft’s older dye aesthetics. Instead of the streamlined modern dye icons, this pack restores the classic, chunkier, retro-styled dyes inspired by early versions of the game.

**Join our Discord below to get notified for updates or releases.**
